extraction_notes: AIRO Group Holdings is a small-cap defense/aerospace SPAC-style rollup (4 segments: Drones [Sky-Watch], Avionics [Aspen], Training [Coastal Defense / Agile Defense], Electric Air Mobility [Jaunt]). The 10-K is unusually LIGHT on specific Pentagon Program Element (PE) numbers or named programs — it speaks in generic categories (adversary air, CAS, ISR, JTAC, tactical resupply, Group 1/2 UAS, NATO partner sales). The MOST material customer concentration is non-DoD (Sky-Watch / European NATO). DoD revenue is contingent on a Blue UAS certification target of June 2026 (FORWARD claim, not yet realized). Most J-Book-grounded claims are pipeline/aspiration, not currently-booked PE revenue. This is itself a finding: the J-Book divergence pattern requires a named, currently-booked PE — AIRO's disclosure provides almost none, which is its own UNVERIFIABLE signal.
